```{r, echo=FALSE}
setwd("/Users/tanxinliu/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversityofSouthernCalifornia/wgs/mutationalsig")
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(caTools)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)
new <-  fread("/Users/tanxinliu/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversityofSouthernCalifornia/wgs/Results/new.csv") 
denovo <- fread("/Users/tanxinliu/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversityofSouthernCalifornia/wgs/mutationalsig/COSMIC_SBS96_Activities.txt")
#change the samples name 
denovo <- denovo %>%
  mutate(Samples = str_sub(Samples, 7))
denovo$Samples=as.numeric(denovo$Samples)
denovo[denovo == 0] <- NA

not_all_na <- function(x) any(!is.na(x))
denovo <- denovo %>% select(where(not_all_na))


new3 <- merge(x = denovo, y = new, by = c("Samples"), all = TRUE)
names(new3)

#recode sample id 1:35
char_vector <- sapply(1:35, function(x) paste0(x))

sampleid <- as.array(char_vector)
new3$sampleid <- sampleid


```


```{r, echo=FALSE}
new3 <- new3 %>% group_by(Samples) %>%
  mutate( sbstotal =sum(c_across(SBS1:SBS30), na.rm = TRUE))
    
summary(new3$sbstotal)

```


```{r, echo=FALSE}
nhigh <- new3 %>% filter(smok==1)
nhigh <- nhigh %>% arrange(sbstotal) %>% select(c("Samples" , "SBS1" , "SBS2" ,"SBS3" ,                  "SBS5" ,  "SBS13" ,"SBS18"   ,   "SBS30" ,"Tobacco_exposure_group", "smok"  ,"sbstotal"  , "sampleid"    ))
names(nhigh)
longnhigh <- gather(nhigh,sbstype,sbscount, SBS1:SBS30, factor_key=TRUE , na.rm=TRUE)
names(longnhigh)
longnhigh$sampleid <- as.character(longnhigh$sampleid) 

longnhigh$sampleid <- factor(longnhigh$sampleid, levels=unique(longnhigh$sampleid))

longnhigh <- longnhigh %>% arrange(sbstotal)
table(longnhigh$sbstype)
names(longnhigh)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)


lhigh<- ggplot(longnhigh, aes(fill=sbstype, y=sbscount, x=sampleid))+
  geom_bar(position='stack', stat='identity')+theme_minimal() + 
  labs(x='\nSamples', y='Number of mutations in each signature', title='Numer of mutations in each signature\nin high tobacco exposure samples')+
  scale_fill_discrete(name="SBS\nsubtype") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 0.5, vjust=.4))

lhigh
 

nlow <- new3 %>% filter(smok==0)
nlow <- nlow %>% arrange(sbstotal) %>% select(c("Samples" , "SBS1" , "SBS2" ,"SBS3" ,                  "SBS5" ,  "SBS13" ,"SBS18"   ,   "SBS30" ,"Tobacco_exposure_group", "smok"  ,"sbstotal"  , "sampleid"    ))
longnlow <- gather(nlow,sbstype,sbscount, SBS1:SBS30, factor_key=TRUE , na.rm=TRUE)

longnlow$sampleid <- as.character(longnlow$sampleid)

longnlow$sampleid <- factor(longnlow$sampleid, levels=unique(longnlow$sampleid))
     
llow<- ggplot(longnlow, aes(fill=sbstype, y=sbscount, x=sampleid))+
  geom_bar(position='stack', stat='identity')+theme_minimal() + 
  labs(x='\nSamples', y='Number of mutations in each signature', title='Numer of mutations in each signature\nin low tobacco exposure samples')+
  scale_fill_discrete(name="SBS\nsubtype") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 0.5, vjust=.4))

llow

```



```{r, echo=FALSE}
#merge longnhigh longnlow
longnlow$Samples <- as.factor(longnlow$Samples)
longnhigh$Samples <- as.factor(longnhigh$Samples)
longnlow$sampleid <- factor(longnlow$sampleid, levels=unique(longnlow$sampleid))
longnhigh$sampleid <- factor(longnhigh$sampleid, levels=unique(longnhigh$sampleid))
longtotal  <- rbind(longnhigh,longnlow)

library(RColorBrewer)
nb.cols <- 7
mycolors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(7, "Set3"))(nb.cols)
library(expss)
longtotal <- apply_labels(longtotal, smok=c("High tobacco exposure"=1, "Low tobacco exposure"=0))

longtotal$sampleid  <- factor(longtotal$sampleid, levels=unique(longtotal$sampleid))




table(longtotal$sbstype)

png(file = "Denovo7_tobacco_2024.png", bg = "white", width = 900, height = 500, units = "px")

ltotal <- ggplot(longtotal, aes(fill=factor(sbstype,levels=c("SBS1","SBS5",  "SBS2","SBS13","SBS3","SBS18","SBS30" )), y=sbscount, x=sampleid))+
  geom_bar(position='stack', stat='identity')+theme_minimal() + 
  scale_fill_discrete(name="SBS\nsubtype") +
  labs(x='\nSample id', y='Number of mutations in each signature\n', title='Numer of mutations in each signature in each sample')+guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Signature"))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 0.5, vjust=.4),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 15))+scale_fill_manual(values = mycolors)+facet_wrap(~smok,scales = "free")

ltotal

dev.off()

ltotal
```



#proportion of mutational signatures

```{r, echo=FALSE}
longtotal$prop = longtotal$sbscount/longtotal$sbstotal

longtotal %>% group_by(sampleid) %>% summarize(n=sum(prop)) # proportions in each sample add to 1
```


```{r, echo=FALSE}
ptotal <- ggplot(longtotal, aes(fill=factor(sbstype,levels=c("SBS1","SBS5",  "SBS2","SBS13","SBS3","SBS18","SBS30")), y=prop, x=sampleid))+
  geom_bar(position='stack', stat='identity')+theme_minimal() + 
  scale_fill_discrete(name="SBS\nsubtype")+
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Signature"))+
  labs(x='\nSample id', y='Proportion\n', title='Proportion of mutations in each sample attributed to each SBS signature')+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 0.5, vjust=.4),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 15))+scale_fill_manual(values = mycolors)+facet_wrap(~smok,scales = "free")

ptotal
```


